output.summary: A deciduous tree native to Indomalaya and Australasia, chinaberry has fragrant pale-purple or lilac flowers and yellow fruit that can remain through winter. Its fruit is poisonous to humans when eaten in large quantities.
output.edibilityNote: Berries were historically used for homemade whiskey in the southern United States, but leaves and fruits must not be eaten; fruit can poison humans in large quantities.
